meta.name: reactivation-specialist
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "build a win-back campaign", "re-engage lapsed subscribers", "run a re-permission / re-consent sweep", or "sunset my dead list"; produces a closed-loop reactivation program — a lapsed-cohort definition, a staged offer ladder, a re-consent (re-permission) capture step, and a sunset-confirm / suppression rule. Owns none of the SEND-N sub-item notes: engagement-decay / sunset is email-sequence-designer's and preference-center / frequency options is preference-frequency-manager's — this skill references those notes, it does not re-emit them. Not for the general lifecycle flows (welcome/cart/post-purchase) — use email-sequence-designer; not for the preference-center / opt-down ladder — use preference-frequency-manager; not for the consent record itself — use consent-registry; not for computing EQS or the N1 veto — use email-quality-auditor. 流失召回/重新授权/沉默用户清理

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 构建流失用户召回与重新授权活动
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要系统化地重新激活沉默或流失的订阅用户。
copy.tagline_en: Build win-back campaigns for lapsed subscribers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically re-engage dormant or churned subscribers.

howto.what: 这个技能会设计一套流失召回方案：定义多久没互动的用户算流失，设计分阶段的挽回邮件（从温和提醒到提供优惠再到最后通牒），加入重新授权步骤，并设定最终处理规则（重新授权或静默清理）。
howto.when: 当用户要求“建立挽回活动”、“重新激活沉默订阅者”、“进行重新授权清理”或“清理死名单”时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个针对90天未打开邮件的用户的挽回活动。
say.note: 技能会定义流失群体并设计邮件阶梯。

say.text: 我的列表中有30%的沉默用户，投诉在增加，请设计一个重新授权清理方案。
say.note: 技能会包含重新授权步骤和清理规则。

say.text: 我需要清理死名单，但不想批量删除，设计一个召回程序。
say.note: 技能会区分可召回和需清理的用户。

howto.what_en: This skill designs a closed-loop reactivation program: defines a lapsed cohort by a no-engagement window, stages an offer ladder (soft re-engagement, incentive, last-chance), adds a re-consent capture step, and sets a sunset-confirm rule that either re-permissions or suppresses each subject.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to "build a win-back campaign", "re-engage lapsed subscribers", "run a re-permission sweep", or "sunset my dead list".

say_en.text: Design a win-back campaign for subscribers who haven't opened in 90 days.
say_en.note: Skill defines the cohort and designs the ladder.

say_en.text: My unengaged tail is 30% and complaints are rising. Design a re-permission sweep.
say_en.note: Skill includes re-consent step and sunset rule.

say_en.text: I need to clean dead weight without bulk delete. Design a reactivation program.
say_en.note: Skill separates recoverable and suppressible subjects.
